# KND Global

> KND Global provides international transport, shipping and logistics, with offices in Malta and Italy.

Founded in 2021, KND Global brings over 25 years of team experience to land, air and maritime transport. Services include groupage, full loads, door-to-door shipments and full-container shipping.
